correctness.rationale: For fixed \(x\), the \(y\)-simplex problem is linear and exactly maximizes \(x\cdot y\) at a largest coordinate. For fixed maximum \(M\), convexity exactly minimizes the remaining squared norm at equal coordinates, leaving a strictly convex one-variable quadratic. This proves the piecewise formula for all \(n\ge2\) and \(a,b\ge0\). The spectral witness satisfies every displayed source constraint by symbolic substitution, and exact rational arithmetic gives the coefficient \(-7N^2/24\).
